    FAQ

    Why can’t I book another free session?

    Each workspace is eligible for one free 1:1 session so we can make expert help available to as many teams as possible.

    Can I pay for another session?

    Yes. If you’d like more help, reach out to the expert you met with and ask about follow-up sessions or additional consulting options.

    Can I meet with a different expert?

    Yes. Visit the Notion Consultant Marketplace to find another certified expert who may be a better fit for your needs.

    What if I need help with a Notion support issue?

    If your question is about your account, billing, a bug, or another customer support issue, please contact [email protected].

    Where can I learn more on my own?

    Notion Academy offers guided learning, best practices, and self-serve resources to help you keep building with Notion.
